candidateHost: Curated London website (addCuratedLondonWebsiteHosts): Harry's Bar & Dining Room states its own website in public/data/pint_prices_app_dataset.json; the UK OSM pub snapshot carries no harrys.co.uk website.
selection: Beer and wine rows the lane stated with a drink name whose ledger key (pub, category, name, serving) the ledger did not already hold. Rows matching a reviewed withdrawal reason are listed under withheld. Rows whose label names no drink, names food, sits in a bottle, can or alcohol-free list (it would read as the pub's draught beer price), carries a serving header the price is not for, names a spirit or a mocktail, or states a half-pint price with no serving are listed under notSelected. Neither list was published. A row with no servingSize is a size the page did not state beside that price.
pageTextQuoted: The page's own lines, re-read on 2026-10-17 through sourcePolicy and a live robots ask, normalised by lib/harvest/ukPriceCrawl.ts pageText (HTML) or lib/harvest/pdfText.ts readPdfText (PDF).
